summary: The StudentPRSelector appears to be a web-based application component related to handling student placement and preference history. It involves user controls for managing student profiles, placement selection, and preference history.
purpose: To facilitate the management and display of student placement selections and preference histories within a web application interface.

workflows.name: Student Placement Selector Workflow
steps: Validate URL hash for session security.
Link child controls based on query string parameters.
Load student profile and display relevant information.
Handle placement selection and preference history tabs.

business_rules: Email links should include the subject line 'HSPnet:'.
Placement selection should ensure unique rankings for each student.

validations.rule: Ensure unique rankings in placement selections

conditions.condition: If the TabContainer is active on Placement Selector or PR Preference History, load the respective user controls.

system_behavior.behavior: Hide error or warning panels when buttons are clicked.
